metadata.title: chore: remove ALTK optional dependency and add pipdeptree
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary
- Remove the `altk` and `toolops` optional dependency groups (agent-lifecycle-toolkit, langchain, langgraph) from `pyproject.toml`
- Remove the `test-altk` Makefile target and its `.PHONY` entry
- Remove stale commented-out `pyre-check` dependency
- Pin `pylint>=3.3.9,<4` to avoid pylint 4.x breaking `.pylintrc` (`suggestion-mode` removed in v4)
- Add `pipdeptree>=2.31.0` to dev dependencies in both root and qr_code_server projects
- Add 187 missing `.PHONY` declarations for Makefile targets listed in `# help:` comments
- Add `.pylintrc.plugins` and `.pylintrc.mcpgateway` for per-target pylint configuration
- Fix 13 genuine code smells in plugins (dangerous-default-value, cell-var-from-loop, redefined-builtin, etc.)
- Update CI lint workflow to use `--rcfile=.pylintrc.$TARGET`
- Update lock files accordingly

## Test plan
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] `make pylint` runs with pylint 3.x (no `suggestion-mode` error)
- [ ] `uv run pylint --rcfile=.pylintrc.plugins plugins --fail-on E --fail-under=10` scores 10.00/10
- [ ] `uv sync --all-extras` resolves cleanly

chore: remove ALTK optional dependency and add pipdeptree

commits.message:
chore: add per-target pylint configs and fix plugin code smells

Add .pylintrc.plugins and .pylintrc.mcpgateway for per-target pylint
configuration. The plugins config adds disables for framework patterns
(unused hook context args, pytest fixtures, lazy Rust imports) while
keeping the bar at 10.0/10.

Fix genuine code smells in plugins:
- dangerous-default-value: mutable [] defaults in llmguard vault methods
- cell-var-from-loop: lambda capturing loop var in html_to_markdown
- inconsistent-return-statements: mixed return/return-value in pii_filter
- redefined-builtin: OPA method parameter renamed input -> opa_input
- implicit-str-concat: merged adjacent string literals in pii_filter_rust
- attribute-defined-outside-init: vault_ttl initialized in __init__
- unused-variable: prefixed with underscore
- unnecessary-pass: removed from mock class with docstring

Update CI lint workflow to use --rcfile=.pylintrc.$TARGET.

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer
